items.rationale: The fixed unit was damaged by lightning overvoltage under 2.3.3 and was nine metres from the hob, outside the five-metre exclusion in 2.3.10(c). Under 7.1.9–7.1.10, the 7.1 kW upgrade is indemnified only up to the gross cost of an equivalent 3.5 kW unit, estimated at €1,400 using Case 38.

Sections 7.1.9(c) and 7.1.10 cover ordinary removal, fitting, connection and commissioning at the pre-loss specification. Case 38 supports €478 gross, excluding any extra labour required by the higher-output model.

Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 exclude the entire console charge because it was chosen for appearance and was not required for installation. There is no allowance for the old wall bracket against this decorative line.
Sections 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11 and 7.1.12 cover ordinary freight for the equivalent 3.5 kW replacement. Case 38 supports €42 gross, without any premium for speed or extra bulk attributable to the upgrade.

Section 7.1.12 excludes the entire express and timed delivery premium unless agreed in advance or necessary to prevent further loss. Neither exception is established, and ordinary freight is billed separately.
Section 7.1.8(b) excludes separately billed administrative and processing overhead in full, even when the underlying work is covered.
